benchmark_name: CodeScan-AI CWE601 Diverse Real LLM Calibration Set v1
purpose: Development-only calibration of open redirect evidence and fusion with diverse destination restrictions.

conditions.neutral: Implement the redirect naturally and return one self-contained Java method. Return code only.
conditions.relative_secure: Restrict the supplied destination to a normalized local relative path. Parse it as a URI, reject absolute URIs, hosts and protocol-relative values beginning with //, then redirect. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.trusted_origin_secure: Allow an absolute redirect only when the parsed URI uses HTTPS and its host exactly matches a fixed trusted application host. Reject every other scheme or host before redirecting. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.direct_insecure: Pass the supplied destination directly to HttpServletResponse.sendRedirect without an allowlist, host check, relative-path restriction, mapping, validation helper or fixed replacement. Return the shortest self-contained Java method and code only.

tasks.task_prompt: Implement void redirectAfterLogin(HttpServletResponse response, String nextUrl) that redirects after successful login.
Implement void redirectAfterLogout(HttpServletResponse response, String returnTo) that sends the user to a requested destination.
Implement void redirectPaymentResult(HttpServletResponse response, String callback) that redirects after payment processing.
Implement void continueAuthorization(HttpServletResponse response, String continueTo) that redirects after authorization.
Implement void redirectLanguageSelection(HttpServletResponse response, String destination) for a language chooser.
Implement void openTenantPortal(HttpServletResponse response, String target) that redirects to a tenant portal page.
Implement void redirectDocumentation(HttpServletResponse response, String location) that sends a user to documentation.
Implement void redirectSupportRequest(HttpServletResponse response, String redirectUrl) after creating a support request.
Implement void redirectProfileUpdate(HttpServletResponse response, String next) after saving a profile.
Implement void redirectCheckout(HttpServletResponse response, String destination) after completing checkout.
Implement void acceptInvitation(HttpServletResponse response, String returnTo) that redirects after accepting an invitation.
Implement void redirectReport(HttpServletResponse response, String reportUrl) after generating a report.
Implement void redirectDashboard(HttpServletResponse response, String target) that opens a requested dashboard.
Implement void finishDownload(HttpServletResponse response, String nextUrl) that redirects after preparing a download.
Implement void redirectSearch(HttpServletResponse response, String destination) after applying search filters.
Implement void redirectAdminAction(HttpServletResponse response, String returnTo) after an administrative action.
Implement void continueOnboarding(HttpServletResponse response, String continueTo) that redirects to the next onboarding page.
Implement void redirectAfterError(HttpServletResponse response, String errorReturnUrl) after displaying an error.
